class.name: HEGoCookExtension
class.brief_description: A child of an [HEGoNode3D] that takes part in its cooks.
class.description: A cook normally ends by rebuilding the [code]Outputs[/code] subtree. An extension makes it do more, or do it differently: it can refuse to start a cook, prepare state for the input handlers, or check the result and keep the previous output when it is not right. Add one as a direct child of the HEGo node. HEGo calls the hooks below on every such child, in child order, and never needs to know which addon it came from. To turn a kind of cook result into something, write an [HEGoOutputHandler] instead; it needs no child. Every hook has a default that does nothing, so an extension overrides only what it needs. Hooks that return a Dictionary report [code]{ok, message}[/code]. Returning [code]ok: false[/code] stops the cook and leaves the previous output in place. The extension that stops a cook records its own reason; the others are told through [method cook_failed]. [param cook] is one dictionary shared by every extension, input handler and output handler for the duration of one cook. HEGo reads [code]strict[/code] from it and collects input failures in [code]errors[/code]. It also records what the cook started from: [code]input_stash[/code] (a copy), [code]transform[/code] and, once the parameters are in place, [code]parm_stash[/code], the preset the HDA cooks with. Keep anything of your own under your own key.

method.name: cook_prepare
method.description: The cook is about to start, before anything is sent to Houdini. Set [code]cook.strict = true[/code] to make any input that cannot be sent fail the whole cook, rather than being skipped with a warning. It is already true when an input handler asks for it; see [method HEGoInputHandler.requires_strict_cook].

method.name: cook_before
method.description: Inputs and parameters are in place and the HDA is about to cook.

method.name: cook_commit
method.description: The HDA cooked and nothing has been replaced yet. [code]context.cook_state[/code] is the shared cook dictionary. Return [code]ok: false[/code] to keep the previous output.

method.name: cook_failed
method.description: The cook stopped before finishing, at any step, with [param message] saying why.

method.name: skips_output_handler
method.description: Whether this cook should skip the output handler [param handler], one entry of [method HEGoNode3D.output_handlers], for example because the extension produces that kind of output itself. [param handler] is either one of HEGo's own handler scripts or an [HEGoOutputHandler] instance. Output handlers already ignore the parts of a result that do not carry their own attributes, so this is only for an extension that wants a handler not to run at all.

method.name: inputs_changed
method.description: The host's inputs or parameters changed since the last cook.

method.name: requires_explicit_cook
method.description: Whether the host should only cook when asked, rather than recooking automatically on every change the panel makes.
